items.title: Cohomology of an object of a ringed site equals cohomology on the localized site
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the cohomology of an object of D(O) at an object U of a ringed site with the cohomology of its restriction on the localized site C/U (statement lines 4328-4333). The proof is a two-line unfolding of the definition of cohomology after choosing a K-injective representative I^bullet, so that both sides become the cohomology of the same section complex, together with the same-chapter observation that restriction to C/U preserves K-injectivity and represents the restricted object (proof lines 4336-4345). The claim is H2: one representative choice and one identification of section complexes.
